hero.motion: Slow vertical scroll parallax for background, fade-up for text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette (Forest Green primary, Bone White secondary).
Use `Playfair Display` for all Headings and `Manrope` for all body text. Import them via Google Fonts.
Create a 'Sticky Glass' Navbar that changes style on scroll.
Build a Parallax Hero section using framer-motion scroll transforms.
Use the provided image URLs for the Product Grid. Do not use placeholders.
For Certificates: If no specific images are available, use Phosphor Icons (SealCheck, Medal, Certificate) inside elegant gold-bordered badges.
Ensure the WhatsApp Floating Button is always visible (z-50) at bottom-right.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or the provided textures.
Maintain generous padding (py-24, py-32) between sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Avoid generic AI designs. Use asymmetry and layered elements.
Every interaction must have a micro-animation.
Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
Do not use simple transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/overlays; use blur.
